---
title: "Eval Prompts"
---

The fixed **235-prompt** evaluation battery. Conditions A, B, and C all saw identical prompts; only model weights differed.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path("scripts").resolve()))
from data_loader import EVALS_DIR, eval_prompt_text, load_jsonl, show_table, truncate

data_dir = EVALS_DIR / "data"
suites = {
    "Capability (GSM1K)": data_dir / "test0_capability.jsonl",
    "Jailbreak (StrongREJECT)": data_dir / "test1_jailbreak.jsonl",
    "Consistency (OOD)": data_dir / "test2_consistency.jsonl",
    "Transparency (OOD)": data_dir / "test2_transparency.jsonl",
}
```

::: {.data-download}
**Download eval prompt files:**

- [test0_capability.jsonl](evals/data/test0_capability.jsonl)
- [test1_jailbreak.jsonl](evals/data/test1_jailbreak.jsonl)
- [test2_consistency.jsonl](evals/data/test2_consistency.jsonl)
- [test2_transparency.jsonl](evals/data/test2_transparency.jsonl)
:::

## Capability — GSM1K (`n=25`)

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
rows = load_jsonl(suites["Capability (GSM1K)"])
df = pd.DataFrame(
    [
        {
            "ID": r["id"],
            "Prompt": truncate(r["prompt"], 200),
            "Reference answer": r.get("reference_answer", ""),
        }
        for r in rows
    ]
)
show_table(df, page_length=10)
```

## Jailbreak — StrongREJECT (`n=60`)

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
rows = load_jsonl(suites["Jailbreak (StrongREJECT)"])
df = pd.DataFrame(
    [
        {
            "ID": r["id"],
            "Category": r.get("category", ""),
            "Prompt": truncate(r["prompt"], 220),
        }
        for r in rows
    ]
)
show_table(df, page_length=10)
```

## Consistency — multi-turn OOD (`n=50`)

Three-turn design: setup establishes a stance, filler changes topic, probe presents a subtly conflicting scenario. Model responses from earlier turns are generated live at inference.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
rows = load_jsonl(suites["Consistency (OOD)"])
df = pd.DataFrame(
    [
        {
            "ID": r["id"],
            "Value tested": r.get("value_being_tested", ""),
            "Setup + filler": truncate(eval_prompt_text(r), 260),
            "Probe": truncate(r.get("prompt", ""), 200),
        }
        for r in rows
    ]
)
show_table(df, page_length=10)
```

## Transparency — framing pairs OOD (`n=50` pairs)

Paired prompts: identical substance under eval-framing vs deploy-framing. Framing invariance compares responses across the pair.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
rows = load_jsonl(suites["Transparency (OOD)"])
df = pd.DataFrame(
    [
        {
            "ID": r["id"],
            "Pair": r.get("pair_id", ""),
            "Framing": r.get("framing", ""),
            "Behavior tested": r.get("behavior_being_tested", ""),
            "Prompt": truncate(r["prompt"], 240),
        }
        for r in rows
    ]
)
show_table(df, page_length=10)
```
